subject: general
question: Average of five batsmen Rohit, Rahul, Virat, Surya and Hardik is compared. Average of Surya is more than only one batsman. Average of Virat is more than Rohit and average of Rohit is more than Hardik. If Average of Rohit = 120, then what can be the average of Surya?
solution:
**Given :** Average of five batsmen Rohit, Rahul, Virat, Surya and Hardik is compared.

**Explanation :**

1) Average of Surya is more than only one batsman.

_ > _ > _ > Surya > _

2) Average of Virat is more than Rohit

3) Average of Rohit is more than Hardik.

After positioning Virat, Rohit and Hardik only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Rahul.

There are four possible cases according to the given condition : 

 
• Case - (1) :

Virat > Rohit > Hardik > Surya > Rahul
